common.disclaimer: This plugin supports compliance with consumer protection law but is not legal advice. Have your terms, labels and processes reviewed by a lawyer.

product.heading: Consumer compliance
product.description: Product safety (GPSR), Omnibus treatment, withdrawal exception and unit prices.
product.saveError: Could not save the compliance data

gpsr.heading: Product safety (GPSR)
gpsr.notApplicable: This product is not covered by GPSR (for example a licence key or a service)
gpsr.identifierHint: Type, model, batch or serial number as printed on the product. Barcodes and SKUs of the variants are shown automatically.
gpsr.noWarningsRequired: The product carries no warnings or safety information
gpsr.accessibilityHint: Text alternative for labels, pictograms or instructions shown as images (European Accessibility Act).

issues.manufacturer_name_missing: Manufacturer has no name or trade name
issues.manufacturer_contact_missing: Manufacturer has no e-mail or website
issues.responsible_person_missing: Manufacturer is outside the EU: an EU responsible person is required
issues.responsible_person_address_missing: Responsible person has no postal address
issues.responsible_person_contact_missing: Responsible person has no e-mail or website
issues.responsible_person_outside_eu: Responsible person is not established in the EU
issues.identifier_missing: No product identifier, barcode or SKU
issues.warnings_not_in_required_language: Warnings are not available in Polish

omnibusModes.standard: Standard: lowest price in the 30 days before the reduction
omnibusModes.perishable: Perishable: price before the first reduction

withdrawalExceptions.custom_made: Excluded: made to the consumer's specification
withdrawalExceptions.perishable: Excluded: perishable or short shelf life
withdrawalExceptions.sealed_hygiene: Excluded once unsealed: health or hygiene reasons
withdrawalExceptions.inseparably_mixed: Excluded: inseparably mixed with other items
withdrawalExceptions.sealed_media: Excluded once unsealed: recordings or software
withdrawalExceptions.digital_content: Excluded with consent: digital content supplied immediately

unit.heading: Unit prices
unit.description: Net quantity per variant. The unit price is computed from the selling price. Deposit (kaucja) is shown separately and is never part of the price.
unit.saveError: Could not save the unit prices

issues.reference_unit_mismatch: Unit price unit does not match the quantity unit
issues.drained_not_mass: Drained weight needs a mass unit

history.heading: Price history (Omnibus)
history.description: Recorded prices per variant and pricing context, and the reference price a storefront must show next to a reduced price.
history.incomplete: The history starts after this product was already on sale. The reference price only covers what the plugin recorded.
history.notHigher: The product was this cheap or cheaper within the window. Presenting this price as a reduction would be misleading.
history.noPriorPrice: There is no earlier price to compare with. Do not present this price as a reduction.
history.noData: No recorded prices in this period yet.
history.legend: Last 90 days. Shaded: reference window. Dashed: reference price.
history.retention: History is kept for {{days}} days, longer where a running reduction needs it.
history.externalDescription: For a price obtainable outside price lists, for example a public discount code. It counts towards the lowest price of later reductions.
history.externalError: Could not record the external price
history.externalInvalid: Fill in the price and both dates.

referenceLabels.lowest_30_days: Lowest price in the 30 days before the reduction
referenceLabels.lowest_since_introduction: Lowest price since the product was introduced

settings.heading: Consumer compliance
settings.description: Texts the storefront shows, economic operators for GPSR, products with gaps and the Omnibus price history.
settings.reviewsHint: Whether and how you ensure that published reviews come from customers who bought or used the product. Required wherever reviews are shown.
settings.personalisedUsed: Prices are personalised on the basis of automated decision-making
settings.personalisedHint: Shown before the order when prices are individually adjusted by automated decisions.
settings.withdrawalInfo: Text next to the withdrawal button
settings.withdrawalInfoHint: Optional. For example where to send the goods back.
settings.omnibusNoteHint: Optional, for example an explanation shown in a tooltip.

operators.description: Manufacturers, EU responsible persons and importers, entered once and assigned to products.
operators.name: Name
operators.tradeName: Registered trade name or trade mark

priceHistory.description: Prices are recorded on every change and reconciled hourly. Record all current prices now after installing the plugin or importing a catalog.

gradualModes.per_change: Each step against the 30 days before it (Polish law)

withdrawals.heading: Withdrawals
withdrawals.description: Statements of withdrawal submitted through the online withdrawal function.
